response.what_it_is: Cordless drill set with two batteries, charger, and accessories in a plastic storage case
hidden_risks: Authenticity and build quality (counterfeit/replica Bosch tools are widespread)
Battery cell quality and actual longevity under load
Durability of the internal motor and gearbox
response.best_proof: The photo showing the drill body and battery pack with the Bosch logo and voltage marking.
seller_claims_unsupported: 48V power rating (genuine professional Bosch cordless tools operate on 12V, 18V, or 36V platforms, not 48V)
response.failure_mode: Mistaking a generic replica power tool bearing a counterfeit Bosch logo and an exaggerated 48V specification for a genuine high-end professional tool.
